source_name: Department of Agriculture Puducherry- Crop Schemes & Incentives
description: Crop subsidies and financial incentives (Paddy: ₹5,000/acre, Pulses: ₹2,000/acre)
limitations: Static HTML table formatting; requires HTML parser

source_name: Department of Agriculture Puducherry - Weekly Reports
description: Weekly agricultural status, rainfall, and crop advisories
limitations: PDF file format; requires PyMuPDF parser

source_name: AGMARKNET - Crop Season Wise Price & Arrival Portal
description: MSP, Kharif/Rabi prices, and arrival tonnage for Paddy, Ragi, Cotton, Sesamum, and Pulses in Karaikal/Pondicherry
limitations: Requires explicit District/Year filter selection and dynamic JavaScript rendering; requires Selenium/Playwright automation

source_name: Department of Agriculture Puducherry - Agricultural Produce Market Prices
description: Historical/retail market prices for primary agricultural commodities (Paddy, Groundnut, Gingelly, Cotton) across Puducherry regulated markets
limitations: Static HTML table structure; updated periodically rather than real-time daily feeds; requires BeautifulSoup parser

source_name: Directorate of Economics & Statistics Puducherry - Season & Crop Report
description: Annual crop area, yield, and district-wise production statistics for Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam
limitations: PDF layout varies year-to-year; requires PyMuPDF table parsing

source_name: Co-operative Department Puducherry - Agricultural Warehousing & Logistics
description: Warehouse locations, storage capacities, PACCS infrastructure, and cold storage facility availability

source_name: Local Government Directory (LGD) - Administrative Boundary Registry
description: Official state district sub-district and village codes for entity normalization
limitations: Requires periodic LGD code lookup mapping
